invariants.rationale: recordMap is passed to construction and used immediately; method likely expects non-null value.
fileId is used as a parameter for handle creation, likely must be non-null.
instantTime is used to indicate the operation time and is expected to be non-null.
partitionPath is a core parameter for location; it is used to construct the handle.
If recordMap is non-empty, its size must be > 0; this expresses a structural property.
